status: Fixed before any model is trained. Any later change must be logged in PROGRESS.md with the reason.

data.dataset: S2-SHIPS (16 L2A tiles, 12 bands, uint16, about 10 m, all acquired April 2021)
data.splits: configs/splits.json: 4-fold, tile-level, 10 train / 2 val / 4 test tiles; overlapping tiles never separated
data.invalid_pixels: Pixels equal to 0 or 65535 in a band are excluded from signal statistics, metrics and the loss.

noise.snr_definition: SNR_b = 10*log10(P_b / N_b); P_b = mean square of band b over the valid pixels of the tile; N_b = average noise variance added to band b.

types.poisson_gaussian: signal-dependent shot noise plus Gaussian read noise; shot_fraction is an assumption, not calibrated to the sensor
types.correlated_gaussian: Gaussian noise with spatial correlation in the resampled bands (Gaussian sd 1 px for 20 m bands, 3 px for 60 m bands, 0 for native 10 m bands)

noise.train_sampling: uniform in dB, drawn on the fly per patch
noise.test_noise: One noisy realisation per (tile, noise type, SNR), seeded by degradation_seed(0, tile, round(SNR*100)) and shared by every model; test patches are crops of it. Recorded in the degradations table.
noise.clipping: none; noise is added to every pixel, including invalid ones
noise.regime_rationale: Reference images carry their own noise, estimated at 47-72 dB (median 56 dB) in this convention; ESA requirements put real Sentinel-2 at about 40-45 dB. Only 35-40 dB approaches nominal sensor noise; 0 dB lies outside the training range (extrapolation test).

evaluation.unit: per-tile metrics on the full tile; test patches are predicted and overlap-averaged
evaluation.psnr_peak: per tile and band, the 99.9th percentile of valid clean pixels (tile_band_stats.peak); never a fixed 65535

regions.water: water-mask pixels outside a 3 px halo around ships
regions.background: every pixel outside a 3 px halo around ships

evaluation.metric_definitions: PSNR per band with the per-band peak then averaged over bands; SSIM uniform 7x7 window, data range = band peak; SAM in degrees over pixels valid in all bands; ERGAS with resolution ratio 1; NRMSE = RMSE / peak. Implemented in src/eval/metrics.py and verified by scripts/check_metrics.py.
evaluation.instance_metrics: Per ship, native 10 m bands B02, B03, B04, B08: ship_nrmse (RMSE over the instance's ship pixels / peak) and contrast_error (|restored contrast - clean contrast| / peak, contrast = mean ship pixels - mean local background). Ship pixels = ship-mask pixels within 4 px of the polygon centroid; local background = non-ship pixels within 10 px, outside a 2 px halo.
evaluation.ship_instances: 1,053 COCO polygons; each counted once via ship_instances.home_patch_id
evaluation.ship_results_reported_against: measured ship contrast-to-noise (tile_ship_contrast) in addition to nominal SNR, because the same nominal SNR gives about a 10x spread in ship visibility across tiles
evaluation.water_mask: The delivered water mask misses the river in rome; do not use it for rome in water-based metrics.

statistics.paired_test: exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on per-tile scores (16 tiles, seeds averaged within tile), src/eval/stats.py
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction within each experiment family
statistics.intervals: Primary: cluster-robust 95% t interval with overlap groups as clusters. Sensitivity: cluster bootstrap (10,000 replicates). A plain bootstrap over ships is not used (it covers about 12% instead of 95% on data shaped like ours).

hypotheses.H1: SNR conditioning beats the blind and FFDNet-style baselines at 0 dB and under a mismatched SNR input (E3, E4).
hypotheses.H2: The cross-band attention block improves SAM and ERGAS by a larger relative margin than PSNR, on gaussian and on correlated_gaussian noise.
hypotheses.H3: The ship-aware loss reduces ship-region error while the global PSNR cost stays below 0.1 dB (pre-specified non-inferiority margin, proposed and open to revision before training).

known_limitations: The clean reference is a real image with its own noise (estimated 47-72 dB).
Synthetic noise approximates real sensor noise; shot fraction is assumed; noise is independent across bands.
16 tiles from 9 areas, one month; about 13 independent overlap groups.
Nominal SNR is tile-relative, so ship visibility varies across tiles at the same SNR.
